icon.title: Tray icon
icon.desc: The bar and the number follow CPU usage live and turn amber from 80%.

card.title: Hover card
card.desc: Shows live CPU, memory, GPU and network readings while the pointer rests on the tray icon. When off, the system tooltip shows instead.

menu.title: Right-clicking the tray icon
menu.desc: The quick panel shows live readings, the busiest processes and common actions; the menu lists the common actions only.

moved.title: Tray and components
moved.desc: The tray icon, the quick panel, what closing the window does and the refresh rate in the tray are now on the Components page.

desktop.title: Desktop monitor
desktop.desc: A widget that keeps chosen readings on the desktop.

taskbar.title: Taskbar monitor
taskbar.desc: CPU, memory and network rates right on the taskbar.

island.title: Dynamic island
island.desc: Live readings and notifications in a capsule at the top of the screen.

card.click: Click: show or hide the window
